0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-5, 14th in the East) are on a four-game losing streak and visit the Philadelphia 76ers (5-1, 1st in the Atlantic), who have won two straight, in what is the Bulls' seventh game of the season. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, and Dailyn Swain is day-to-day with back soreness and a game-time decision, while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Joel Embiid (foot), and LeBron James (back). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Bulls won the 2025-26 series 2-1, but the most recent meeting, on March 25, 2026 in Philadelphia, ended with the 76ers winning 157-137.
